title: Zesty Malaysian Tofu Noodles
description: A flavorful and aromatic Malaysian dish featuring crispy tofu, noodles, and a tangy sauce, made in a wok and perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is Buddhist-temple-friendly and can be adjusted to suit various tastes.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and add the tofu, cooking until golden brown on all sides.
Remove the tofu from the wok and set aside, leaving the oil behind.
Add the garlic and ginger to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mustard, soy sauce, and brown sugar to the wok, stirring to combine and deglaze the bottom.
Add the cooked noodles to the wok, stirring to combine with the sauce.
Return the tofu to the wok and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Add the parsley and water to the wok, stirring to combine and create a gooey sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the noodles are well coated.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
